answer: Each agent identity is registered to a remotely attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) and a hardware-rooted key, so copied VM images cannot by themselves forge additional enclave credentials. The verifier checks the measurement and enforces one identity per authorized hardware credential; creating more identities therefore requires access to additional physical silicon, not merely a mirror of the software. A raven-marked test token and a pearl nonce can help detect replay, but do not replace attestation.
